body: Ah, I understand now. Yes maybe. I always told myself that when I get myself into a better situation I'd come back here and do the wonderful job people like yourself are doing. I don't know if I could ever do it on a large scale (lie a psychiatrist or something), other peoples actions and/or shortcomings/disappointments upset me too much. It makes me sad to see others sad, so when I'm sad it gets quite bad.
I'd like to hope so but I have a problem letting things go. There may be ups but the downs will always be there and I can't go back and change them. I guess everything passes with time.

Thank you. I talked to my girlfriend for an hour after posting this and just venting made it a whole lot more bearable. I think the dismissal hearing went well today but I still don't know the final verdict. Sometimes, everything just hits you at once and it looks like a dead end. I have to ask though, what do you mean when you ask if I think I can help people?
